A '''Fleshtrap''' is a {{Rare}} [[Mutation]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''Fleshtrap''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Cindershade|amount=4}} and {{Item|Lonelily|amount=4}} within {{Green|1}} block of farmland.

While growing, a '''Fleshtrap''' needs water and has {{Green|14}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it allows for additional items to be found.

'''Fleshtraps''' require meat-based food items while growing. The player can feed it by right-clicking the '''Fleshtrap''' with the food item. Different types of food provide different effects:

* Basic food simply recovers 2 points of hunger.
* Enchanted food recovers 4 points of hunger, as well as adding a {{Aqua|+20%}} bonus drop onto the '''Fleshtrap'''.
* Enchanted cooked food ([[Enchanted Cooked Mutton|Mutton]], [[Enchanted Cooked Rabbit|Rabbit]], etc.) recovers 6 points of hunger and adding a {{Aqua|+40%}} bonus drop.

The bonus drop caps at {{Aqua|+100%}}, though it still has a chance to give up to 3 Fleshtraps. It is not recommended to feed it enchanted '''cooked''' food as enchanted food is enough to reach the cap. Basic food can be fed after it reaches the cap in order to sustain it, as a '''Fleshtrap''' cannot grow if its hunger reaches 0.

== Crop Drops ==
When harvested, '''Fleshtraps''' also drop {{Item|Pumpkin|amount=289}}, {{Item|Potato|amount=510}}, {{Item|Carrot|amount=595}}, and {{Skill XP|2720 Farming}}.

== Usage ==
=== Crop Analyzer ===
A '''Fleshtrap''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|360k}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|180}}. The first time analyzing a '''Fleshtrap''' grants an additional {{Copper|750}}.

=== Mutations ===
'''Fleshtraps''' are used to create a {{Item|Zombud}}.
